lost_leads.pain_stat: Does a new lead's form reach someone immediately or wait until checked?
lost_leads.automation_one_liner: the second someone fills out a form, it's already routed to the right person's phone

manual_reporting.pain_hook: the data entry for client reports
manual_reporting.pain_stat: At the start of every month, is someone on your team still pulling numbers from three different ad platforms and pasting them into a deck by hand?
manual_reporting.automation_one_liner: the report builds itself and lands in the client's inbox before anyone has to open a spreadsheet

onboarding_chaos.pain_hook: folder and account setup for new clients
onboarding_chaos.pain_stat: When a new client signs, is someone manually creating the Slack channel, the Drive folder, and the project board every single time?
onboarding_chaos.automation_one_liner: the folders, channels, and kickoff tasks are already waiting the moment the contract's signed

budget_overspend.pain_stat: Has a client's ad budget ever quietly blown past what was agreed on before anyone noticed?
budget_overspend.automation_one_liner: you get a quiet ping the moment a budget's pacing too fast, instead of finding out at the invoice

approval_bottlenecks.pain_stat: Are your account managers stuck chasing the same client for a sign-off across email, Slack, and text before a campaign can even launch?
approval_bottlenecks.automation_one_liner: the reminders chase the client automatically, so your team isn't the one doing the chasing

scope_creep.pain_stat: When a client slips in one more small request that's technically outside the contract, is anyone actually flagging it before your team just quietly does the work?
scope_creep.automation_one_liner: out-of-scope requests get flagged the moment they land, before anyone starts working for free

crm_chaos.pain_hook: organizing new leads in your CRM
crm_chaos.pain_stat: If I asked right now who owns your newest lead and what the next step is, could anyone on your team actually answer that in ten seconds?
crm_chaos.automation_one_liner: every lead gets an owner and a next step the second it comes in, no matter where it came from

internal_comms_failures.pain_stat: Has a client's change request ever gotten lost between their email and your team's task list, so the old version went out anyway?
internal_comms_failures.automation_one_liner: a task gets created and assigned automatically the moment a change request comes in

manual_proposals.pain_stat: Is someone still building every new proposal from scratch, copying old case studies and retyping pricing every single time?
manual_proposals.automation_one_liner: the pricing and case studies fill themselves in the moment a deal reaches proposal stage

profitability_blindness.pain_hook: tracking project hours against the budget
profitability_blindness.pain_stat: Do you find out a project went over budget while it's happening, or only after it's already over and the damage is done?
profitability_blindness.automation_one_liner: you get a heads-up the moment a project crosses 70% of its budgeted hours, while there's still time to act

pipeline_generation.pain_stat: If referrals slowed down for a quarter, is there an actual outbound engine bringing in new business, or would the pipeline just go quiet?
pipeline_generation.automation_one_liner: outbound runs on its own in the background, so growth doesn't depend entirely on who happens to refer you

billable_hour_leakage.pain_stat: Is your team still manually logging hours at the end of the day, and how much do you think actually gets forgotten and never billed?
billable_hour_leakage.automation_one_liner: hours get captured automatically as the work happens and sync straight to invoicing
